parsers.doc:
A 1x`steps` reply under the D-76 rules (see the module text). `repeats`: "identical" (D-90, the official rule) or "strict"
(the original rule of prereg-lock-2: any repeated step line fails).
parsers.name: parse_trace
parsers.what: a chain reply's step lines and Answer line

parsers.doc:
A 24x1 reply: the last Answer line (`last_answer_text`, the same definition as 1x24) with the D-76 value rules for each entry. Status, in order:
`no_answer`, `misnumbered` (an entry number outside 1..width), `non_integer` / `wrong_length` (the first bad entry), `missing_line`
(a number not given).
parsers.name: parse_pieces
parsers.what: a pieces reply's per-sequence Answer lines

parsers.doc:
The last Answer line of a one-sequence reply, read by the value rules: ("ok", state) or (reason, None). The `1 =` label is
optional. Used for the Answer line of a trace and for the answer-only fallback prompt (D-36(5); D-76: answer-only fallback).
parsers.name: parse_final
parsers.what: a reply's last Answer line as a state

parsers.doc:
What one try votes for under `score`, or None (a vote for nothing): no answer (kind not "answered"); on a trace row, official and
copy-forgiven: a format that is not ok. Official votes the whole trace; final votes the Answer state; copy-forgiven votes RIGHT_TRACE
for a right or copy-slip trace and the trace otherwise. Rows that are not trace rows vote their `answer_key`.
parsers.name: vote_key

parsers.doc:
Whether one try is right under `score` ("official", "final", "copy_forgiven" or "original"). "original" is the official score
under prereg-lock-2's repeat rule (D-90's sensitivity view, `correct_original`); a row with no `correct_original` field was graded
before D-90, under that same rule, so it reads its `correct`. Rows that are not trace rows use `correct`. This
reads ONE row, so it cannot see an answer-only / step-line mix: that check is set-level (`check_answer_only`, called by
`arm_scores`, `format_compliance` and `rates_1x24`).
parsers.name: row_correct

parsers.doc: The state a step reply votes for (`scoring.state_key`), or None when its Answer line does not read as a state.
parsers.name: parse_step_answer
parsers.what: what one step call votes for (step voting)

parsers.doc: The n task texts, or None if the plan does not have exactly tasks 1..n (then E2 fails on that puzzle).
parsers.name: parse_plan

parsers.doc: The chosen reply number 1..8 from the LAST `Pick:` line, or None (then the picker gives no answer).
parsers.name: parse_pick
